versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִ֥י כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ שָׂפָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּדְבָרִ֖ים אֲחָדִֽים׃

controles.web: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
controles.kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
controles.livre: Era, então, toda a terra de uma língua e umas mesmas palavras.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִ֖י בְּנָסְעָ֣ם מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַֽיִּמְצְא֥וּ בִקְעָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando se partiram do oriente, acharam um vale na terra de Sinear; e ali passaram a habitar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ הָ֚בָה נִלְבְּנָ֣ה לְבֵנִ֔ים וְנִשְׂרְפָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וַתְּהִ֨י לָהֶ֤ם הַלְּבֵנָה֙ לְאָ֔בֶן וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ר הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לַחֹֽמֶר׃

controles.web: They said one to another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
controles.kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
controles.livre: E disseram uns aos outros: Vinde, façamos tijolos e o cozamos com fogo. E foi-lhes os tijolos em lugar de pedra, e o betume em lugar de argamassa.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ הָ֣בָה׀ נִבְנֶה־לָּ֣נוּ עִ֗יר וּמִגְדָּל֙ וְרֹאשׁ֣וֹ בַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֖נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן־נָפ֖וּץ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make ourselves a name, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
controles.kjv: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
controles.livre: E disseram: Vamos, edifiquemo-nos uma cidade e uma torre, cuja ponta chegue ao céu; e façamo-nos um nome, para que não sejamos espalhados sobre a face de toda a terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֣רֶד יְהוָ֔ה לִרְאֹ֥ת אֶת־הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־הַמִּגְדָּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
controles.kjv: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
controles.livre: E desceu o SENHOR para ver a cidade e a torre que edificavam os filhos dos homens.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה הֵ֣ן עַ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְשָׂפָ֤ה אַחַת֙ לְכֻלָּ֔ם וְזֶ֖ה הַחִלָּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְעַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

controles.web: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
controles.livre: E disse o SENHOR: Eis que o povo é um, e todos estes têm uma língua; e começaram a agir, e nada lhes restringirá agora do que pensaram fazer.

versos.hebraico: הָ֚בָה נֵֽרְדָ֔ה וְנָבְלָ֥ה שָׁ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפַ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
controles.kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, desçamos, e confundamos ali suas línguas, para que ninguém entenda a fala de seu companheiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨פֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם מִשָּׁ֖ם עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחְדְּל֖וּ לִבְנֹ֥ת הָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
controles.kjv: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
controles.livre: Assim os espalhou o SENHOR desde ali sobre a face de toda a terra, e deixaram de edificar a cidade.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּי־שָׁ֛ם בָּלַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה שְׂפַ֣ת כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמִשָּׁם֙ הֱפִיצָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַל־פְּנֵ֖י כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

controles.web: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
controles.kjv: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
controles.livre: Por isto foi chamado o nome dela Babel, porque ali confundiu o SENHOR a língua de toda a terra, e desde ali os espalhou sobre a face de toda a terra.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת שֵׁ֔ם שֵׁ֚ם בֶּן־מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֑ד שְׁנָתַ֖יִם אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃

controles.web: This is the history of the generations of Shem. Shem was one hundred years old and became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
controles.kjv: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
controles.livre: Estas são as gerações de Sem: Sem, de idade de cem anos, gerou a Arfaxade, dois anos depois do dilúvio.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Sem, depois que gerou a Arfaxade quinhentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֣ד חַ֔י חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־שָֽׁלַח׃

controles.web: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
controles.kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
controles.livre: E Arfaxade viveu trinta e cinco anos, e gerou a Salá.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִ֣י אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֗ד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שֶׁ֔לַח שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Arfaxade, depois que gerou a Salá, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֥לַח חַ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃

controles.web: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber:
controles.kjv: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
controles.livre: E viveu Salá trinta anos, e gerou a Héber.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־שֶׁ֗לַח אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־עֵ֔בֶר שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: and Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Salá, depois que gerou a Héber, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־עֵ֕בֶר אַרְבַּ֥ע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־פָּֽלֶג׃

controles.web: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
controles.kjv: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
controles.livre: E viveu Héber trinta e quatro anos, e gerou a Pelegue.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־עֵ֗בֶר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־פֶּ֔לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Héber, depois que gerou a Pelegue, quatrocentos e trinta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־פֶ֖לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־רְעֽוּ׃

controles.web: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
controles.kjv: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
controles.livre: E viveu Pelegue, trinta anos, e gerou a Reú.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־פֶ֗לֶג אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־רְע֔וּ תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Pelegue, depois que gerou a Reú, duzentos e nove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֔וּ שְׁתַּ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־שְׂרֽוּג׃

controles.web: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
controles.kjv: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
controles.livre: E Reú viveu trinta e dois anos, e gerou a Serugue.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שְׂר֔וּג שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Reú, depois que gerou a Serugue, duzentos e sete anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֥י שְׂר֖וּג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־נָחֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
controles.kjv: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
controles.livre: E viveu Serugue trinta anos, e gerou a Naor.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י שְׂר֗וּג אַחֲרֵ֛י הוֹלִיד֥וֹ אֶת־נָח֖וֹר מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Serugue, depois que gerou a Naor, duzentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֔וֹר תֵּ֥שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־תָּֽרַח׃

controles.web: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
controles.kjv: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
controles.livre: E viveu Naor vinte e nove anos, e gerou a Terá.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֗וֹר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־תֶּ֔רַח תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of sons and daughters.
controles.kjv: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
controles.livre: E viveu Naor, depois que gerou a Terá, cento e dezenove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְחִי־תֶ֖רַח שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֨וֹלֶד֙ אֶת־אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־הָרָֽן׃

controles.web: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
controles.kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
controles.livre: E viveu Terá setenta anos, e gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת תֶּ֔רַח תֶּ֚רַח הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־הָרָ֑ן וְהָרָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־לֽוֹט׃

controles.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
controles.kjv: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
controles.livre: Estas são as gerações de Terá: Terá gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã; e Harã gerou a Ló.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣מָת הָרָ֔ן עַל־פְּנֵ֖י תֶּ֣רַח אָבִ֑יו בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּ֖וֹ בְּא֥וּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

controles.web: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.
controles.kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
controles.livre: E morreu Harã antes que seu pai Terá na terra de seu nascimento, em Ur dos caldeus.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָ֧ם וְנָח֛וֹר לָהֶ֖ם נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־אַבְרָם֙ שָׂרָ֔י וְשֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־נָחוֹר֙ מִלְכָּ֔ה בַּת־הָרָ֥ן אֲבִֽי־מִלְכָּ֖ה וַֽאֲבִ֥י יִסְכָּֽה׃

controles.web: Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.
controles.kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
controles.livre: E tomaram Abrão e Naor para si mulheres: o nome da mulher de Abrão foi Sarai, e o nome da mulher de Naor, Milca, filha de Harã, pai de Milca e de Iscá.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִ֥י שָׂרַ֖י עֲקָרָ֑ה אֵ֥ין לָ֖הּ וָלָֽד׃

controles.web: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
controles.kjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
controles.livre: Mas Sarai era estéril, e não tinha filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח תֶּ֜רַח אֶת־אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ל֤וֹט בֶּן־הָרָן֙ בֶּן־בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ שָׂרַ֣י כַּלָּת֔וֹ אֵ֖שֶׁת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ אִתָּ֜ם מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים לָלֶ֨כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַד־חָרָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
controles.kjv: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
controles.livre: E tomou Terá a Abrão seu filho, e a Ló filho de Harã, filho de seu filho, e a Sarai sua nora, mulher de Abrão seu filho: e saiu com eles de Ur dos caldeus, para ir à terra de Canaã: e vieram até Harã, e assentaram ali.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־תֶ֔רַח חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֥מָת תֶּ֖רַח בְּחָרָֽן׃ס

controles.web: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
controles.kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
controles.livre: E foram os dias de Terá duzentos e cinco anos; e morreu Terá em Harã.
